Under the directives of Mohammed bin Rashid, Dubai Humanitarian launches a new air bridge to support humanitarian relief efforts in Gaza. The first flight, carrying essential supplies and thermal winter blankets for UNICEF, has arrived in Al Arish, Egypt. The air bridge involves multiple flights operated by the Dubai Royal Air Wing using C-130 aircraft, each carrying approximately nine metric tonnes of humanitarian supplies. At least three additional flights are scheduled in the coming days to deliver blankets for children and other vulnerable groups, helping families prepare for the approaching winter.
